tickets.title: Backup and Restore UI
tickets.description: Admin-only backup/restore page. Create database backup, restore via upload, show backup history where possible, warn before restore, protect for staff/superuser.

tickets.title: Meter Management
tickets.description: Allow changing meter assigned to unit/lease, add prepaid meter option, show current tenant on dashboard, maintain meter change history where possible, avoid losing old readings.

tickets.title: Suggestion / Error Reporting
tickets.description: Complete suggestion/error module with type, title, description, optional screenshot/photo, status, created_by, created_at, admin reply, user visibility for own reports.

tickets.title: Building / Unit / Lease Photos and Videos
tickets.description: Store photos/videos for buildings and units, lease photos for damage/condition/handover proof, with caption, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, and future tenant sharing support.

tickets.title: Maintenance Collection Report
tickets.description: Add maintenance collection report for selected period with active/inactive tenants, filters for date range/building/unit/tenant status, exports if pattern exists, and clear totals.

tickets.title: Late Fees
tickets.description: Add late fee support for invoices/payments and tenant messages, avoid duplicate late fee application, allow admin amount/percentage config if settings support it.

tickets.title: Billing Cap
tickets.description: Inspect existing billing/invoice code, review or implement billing cap logic, prevent exceeding configured cap, and show clear cap reached message.

tickets.title: Security Deposit Refund
tickets.description: Improve refund workflow with refund amount, deductions, reason, date, payment method, status, balance after deductions, and prevention of refund over available deposit.

tickets.title: Tenant Registration Link
tickets.description: Add public signed/UUID tenant registration link where tenant can submit/update details, admin can review/approve, and token can expire.

tickets.title: Police Verification
tickets.description: Add police verification details to tenant/lease, including status, existing CNIC/passport info, verification date, document upload, remarks, and display on detail pages.

tickets.title: Property Unit Count Issue
tickets.description: Inspect property/building/unit relationships and fix property unit counts using actual related active/inactive units, avoiding hardcoded counts unless required.

tickets.title: Lease Renewal
tickets.description: Add renewal workflow from existing lease with new dates/rent/security/terms, close old lease properly, prevent overlapping active leases, and keep renewal history.

tickets.title: Lease Agreement Print
tickets.description: Add printable lease agreement using existing lease/tenant/property/unit/rent/security/terms data, clean print/PDF template, and print button on lease detail.

tickets.title: Delete Payment Fix
tickets.description: Inspect payment relations, fix delete payment, update invoice/payment balance correctly, prevent accounting corruption unless admin confirms, and show messages.

tickets.title: Delete Invoice Line Item
tickets.description: Allow deleting invoice line item with confirmation, recalculate invoice total/balance/status, and prevent deletion when linked payment/accounting would break.

tickets.title: Payment Message Cleanup
tickets.description: Hide zero or blank amount line items in payment messages while keeping totals correct.

tickets.title: Maintenance Request Module
tickets.description: Add maintenance request feature with tenant/building/unit/lease/title/description/category/priority/status/dates/assigned_to/cost/media, list/detail/filter pages, admin status updates, and report linkage.
